audit.whatIsWrong: QA lint pass: remaining MISGENDER / COPY_PASTE_BLEED / COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT findings after main audit.
audit.why: matchup-lint reported these classes; QA pass owns driving them to 0.

edits.before: E-shield in, E2-chain, Q-W with whirls between, heal out — the full brawl string he answered with one rotation and regret.
edits.after: Kingslayer telegraphs its lunge — chain him during the wind-up and his heal-strike lands on a shielded, stunned target.

edits.before: Chaining into a loaded CC with W down — Sylas without the heal is a mage who chose melee for the aesthetic.
edits.after: Mirror brawls swing on whose E-shield and Kingslayer are up — with yours down and his ready, even HP is a loss.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - E Abscond (shield-dash) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Abscond / Abduct is 13s at rank 1 for both — dash into chain-stun; punish him while his is down, it governs forward steps. - Hijack is 80/55/30s on each side — spend stolen ults faster than he does. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
